<thought>Search the template catalog using bond changes characteristic of a carbonyl‑ene reaction: break a C=C and a C=O bond, form a C‑C bond, and change the order of the C=C and C=O bonds. This broader query should retrieve applicable retrosynthetic templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=C", "C=O"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C=C (2.0->1.0)", "C=O (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
